subject: Re: ArchonBio — GCP private offer procurement checkpoints & invoice handoff
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@archonbio.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GCP private offer — procurement checkpoints & invoice routing

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at ArchonBio is ready to move forward on the GCP private offer, but we need a short mutual action plan to share with our finance and legal teams so we can align on key checkpoints and invoice routing. High-level ask:

- A procurement timeline (legal review, PO issuance, private-offer acceptance)
- Who signs the private offer and the DocuSign link expectations
- How invoices will be routed (billing contact, vendor code, bill-to vs remit-to)
- Any required attachment (SOC2 evidence, data processing addendum) and expected turnaround

Can you send a concise runbook we can attach to our internal submission?

Procurement contacts: procurement@archonbio.com (cc'd), Ravi Patel (ravi.p@archonbio.com) is our finance lead for vendor onboarding.

Appreciate a week-turnaround if possible — we are aiming to issue a PO late next week.

Best,
Sara Nguyen
Director, Strategic Ops
ArchonBio

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@archonbio.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — procurement checkpoints & invoice routing

Sara — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (Account Exec) and Karthik (Solutions Engineer) so we can turn this into a one-page runbook for your finance/legal teams.

Proposed quick responses to your bullets:
- Timeline: draft MAP below — we’ll convert to a single-slide MAP and a checklist you can attach.
  * Legal & procurement review: target Nov 16–18
  * PO issuance: target Nov 20
  * Redwood submits private-offer acceptance & provisions: target Nov 22
  * GCP private offer activation & billing start: target Dec 1
- DocuSign: we can send the private-offer link; signatory on our side is VP Strategic Accounts (I will include the appropriate signer).
- Invoice routing: we typically invoice to the bill-to you provide and remit to Redwood North America. We can map to your vendor code; Karthik will attach a diagram and the fields we need (vendor code, remit address, tax info).
- Evidence: SOC 2 + DPA are available; we’ll attach SOC 2 scope and a standard DPA redline window.

Karthik — can you attach the MAP spreadsheet and the invoice-routing diagram? Laura — will you prepare a short note that confirms signatory and SLA expectations for legal?

I’ll follow up with a single PDF runbook and the DocuSign link once we have attachments.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@archonbio.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: ArchonBio MAP and invoice routing diagram (attachments)

Sara / Marcus — attaching the requested artifacts: ArchonBio_MAP_v2.xlsx and InvoiceRoutingDiagram.pdf. Also including our standard Redwood_PO_Terms.docx so procurement can validate invoicing cadence and payment terms. (Attachment stubs below.)

Quick summary (please let me know if you want different targets):
- Legal review window: Nov 16–18 (we will highlight any non-standard DPA items immediately)
- Procurement to issue PO: target Nov 20 (ArchonBio PO number required in the DocuSign acceptance)
- Redwood accepts private offer and provisions GCP billing: we will accept the private offer within 48 hours of receiving your PO and DocuSign signature (target Nov 22)
- Billing start date: first invoice covers usage through the end of the calendar month; anticipated first invoice issued Dec 1 and due Net 30

Invoice fields we need populated (from diagram):
- ArchonBio vendor code (mandatory)
- Bill-to name and address (for invoice)
- Remit-to details (Redwood remit instructions in Redwood_PO_Terms.docx)
- Tax ID / VAT if applicable

If procurement prefers a sample invoice to validate ingestion to your AP system, we can generate a non-financial sample using the expected fields.

Attachments (stubs):
- ArchonBio_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, dependencies)
- InvoiceRoutingDiagram.pdf (visual of bill-to/remit-to/vendor-code mapping)
- Redwood_PO_Terms.docx (standard PO terms, invoicing cadence, tax info)

Related links: HubSpot deal link and a placeholder DocuSign room (below).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0229

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@archonbio.com>

Subject: Re: ArchonBio MAP and invoice routing diagram (attachments)

Thanks — the MAP and diagram look good to Procurement. We will:

- Run legal review today (Nov 20) using the Redwood_PO_Terms.docx as the baseline
- Target PO issuance by COB Nov 20; Ravi will push through the vendor onboarding queue and confirm vendor code by tomorrow
- We will attach ArchonBio_PO_Template.pdf (attached) to the PO submission so Redwood sees the exact AP fields required

Request: can Redwood send one sample, non-bill invoice stub (PDF) with the vendor code once it is available? That will make our AP ingestion much faster.

We anticipate moving forward on the timeline you outlined — will confirm PO number and vendor code by Nov 21. If anything changes we will update.

Best,
Sara Nguyen
Director, Strategic Ops | ArchonBio
procurement@archonbio.com
